title: Commercial Brand Manager
description:
Commercial Brand Marketing Manager

Flexible Location (Hybrid Work)

Are you an experienced brand marketer with a passion for developing impactful campaigns and building strong brand presence? We're looking for a Brand Manager to join our marketing team and play a key role in shaping and delivering brand strategy across a portfolio of products and brands.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead high profile campaigns, manage key partnerships and suppliers, and influence brand performance across multiple marketing channels.

The Role

As Brand Manager, you'll support the Brand Marketing Lead in developing and delivering integrated brand campaigns that drive awareness, engagement and commercial growth. You'll oversee campaign execution from concept through to delivery, manage budgets and supplier relationships, and use performance insights to shape future marketing activity.

What You'll Be Doing
- Leading the development and delivery of multi channel brand campaigns
- Managing supplier, agency and ambassador relationships to maximise campaign performance
- Identifying new marketing opportunities and supporting brand growth initiatives
- Overseeing media planning and placement across advertising, sponsorship and events
- Managing campaign budgets and tracking performance against objectives
- Analysing campaign results and providing recommendations for future activity
- Leading annual reviews of marketing collateral and brand assets
- Working closely with internal stakeholders to ensure campaigns align with business objectives
- Supporting and attending events, sponsorship activations and promotional activities
- Managing customer communications in line with GDPR, FCA and regulatory requirements
- Line managing and developing junior marketing team members

Essential Skills & Experience
- Proven experience in a brand, campaign or marketing management role
- Strong campaign planning and project management skills
- Experience managing agencies, suppliers or commercial partnerships
- Ability to analyse campaign performance and interpret business data
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Strong commercial awareness and creative thinking
- High attention to detail and organisational skills
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Experience within financial services or a regulated industry
- Experience managing ambassador or sponsorship partnerships
- CIM qualification or equivalent marketing qualification
- Proven experience delivering brand and marketing campaigns within a commercial B2 B environment

title: Communications Officer
description:
Consula is working with an organisation to recruit a confident, organised and creative Communications Officer. This is a client-employed role, with the successful candidate joining the hiring organisation directly.

This opportunity is suited to someone who enjoys turning ideas, information and organisational priorities into clear communications that people want to read, understand and act on. You will help shape how the organisation communicates with colleagues, partners, customers and wider audiences, ensuring that messages are accurate, engaging and consistent.

The role offers a varied workload across internal communications, digital content, campaigns, stakeholder updates and day-to-day communications support. You will have the opportunity to contribute ideas, take ownership of content and make a visible difference to how the organisation presents itself.

About the role

As Communications Officer, you will support the development and delivery of communications activity across a range of channels. You will work closely with colleagues to understand key priorities, identify strong stories and create content that is clear, relevant and aligned with the organisation's brand and values.

You will be comfortable writing for different audiences and formats, from web pages and newsletters to social-media content, briefing notes, internal updates and campaign materials. You will also help maintain communication plans, coordinate approvals and ensure published content remains accurate and up to date.

This role would suit someone with a strong writing background, sound digital awareness and the confidence to manage a varied workload in a busy, collaborative environment.

Key responsibilities
- Draft, edit and publish clear, engaging communications for internal and external audiences.
- Support the delivery of communication plans, campaigns and stakeholder-engagement activity.
- Create content for digital channels, including websites, newsletters, email communications and relevant social-media platforms.
- Work with colleagues to identify stories, updates and opportunities that should be communicated to key audiences.
- Maintain content calendars, communications schedules and approval processes.
- Ensure communications are accurate, accessible, timely and consistent with the organisation's brand and tone of voice.
- Support the development of presentations, briefing notes, case studies, reports and campaign materials.
- Coordinate with internal teams, external partners and suppliers to support effective delivery of communications activity.
- Monitor engagement and performance across relevant channels, using insight to improve future content.
- Keep web and digital information up to date and identify opportunities to improve clarity, accessibility and user experience.
- Support communications during key organisational activity, events, announcements or change programmes as required.

About you

You will have experience in communications, marketing, public relations, content creation, digital engagement or a related role. You will be an excellent writer with strong attention to detail and the ability to make complex information clear, concise and engaging.

You will be organised, adaptable and comfortable managing multiple deadlines. You will have confidence using standard office systems and digital communications tools, and you will understand how different channels can be used to reach different audiences.

Experience of managing website content, email campaigns, newsletters, social-media channels, stakeholder communications or internal engagement would be beneficial. Experience in a public-facing, community, housing, education, health, public-sector or professional-services setting would also be useful, but is not essential.

A relevant qualification in communications, marketing, journalism, public relations, media, English or a related discipline is desirable. Equivalent experience will be considered.

What the client offers

The successful candidate will join a supportive team and have the opportunity to contribute to communications work with clear purpose and visible impact. The client offers a professional environment in which people are encouraged to bring ideas, develop their skills and take pride in high-quality work.

This organisation is recruiting directly through Consula, their recruitment partner.

title: Consumer Social Media Account Director - Manchester/Hybrid
company: Black Cherry Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
My client is a leading Manchester digital and PR agency that are on the lookout for a Consumer Social Media Account Director with energy and ideas, who is adept at managing teams and world class social media campaigns.

The client portfolio will be centred around the FMCG, sport, retail, food and drink, transport and lifestyle.

Working logistics - Manchester office/Hybrid. 3 days office, 2 days home.

They are looking for someone that understands what it takes to develop successful consumer social media strategies that affect real change in audience perception and behaviour.

As an Account Director, you will be working closely with your account head to advise and steer market-leading brands, specifically our key social account, in an environment and with a team that will help you reach your potential and support you in your growth.

Specifically, your responsibilities will include:

Client Relationships
- Cultivate strong relationships with clients, providing counsel on marketing and communications strategies including PR and social media and how to amplify content through paid.
- Immersing yourself within the client's businesses, proactively becoming an integral part of the client's marketing team
- Ensure clients understand the agency's services, maximising growth opportunities.

Strong Delivery
- Work with the wider team to craft and deliver winning communications strategies to match client briefs.
- Act as a champion for strategic, creative communications for your team that delivers both the client's brief and KPIs.
- Ensure a high quality of innovative and forward-thinking work is delivered to client timescales.

Team Management
- Manage a team of communications specialists, acting as a mentor and a coach for the day-to-day operations, with the support of the Associate Director.
- Work closely with other leads on capacity planning, people development and team training.

You should apply if you have
- You thrive in the agency environment, enjoying the creative challenges, fast pace, and thrill of seeing your strategies brought to life
- You, ideally, have several years' experience leading a variety of accounts across multiple sectors
- You are experienced in running campaigns that span earned, shared, and owned media, with an in-depth knowledge of traditional and social media landscapes
- You have experience in influencer engagement and both internal and external stakeholder management
- You are familiar with agency client management and comfortable managing, motivating and guiding teams, nurturing talent internally
- You enjoy crafting organic and new business proposals from small projects to bigger and wider communication strategies

title: Senior PR Executive
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
A Senior PR Executive role based in North Manchester, focused on managing public relations activities to enhance brand visibility and reputation. You'll work closely with the marketing team to create and deliver effective communication strategies that support business goals.

Client Details

An organisation in the marketing and agency sector, based in North Manchester .

Description
- Develop and execute PR campaigns to align with the company's marketing strategy.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with media outlets and journalists.
- Monitor and manage press coverage, ensuring accurate representation of the brand.
- Draft press releases, articles, and other communication materials.
- Coordinate events and media opportunities to promote the brand.
- Analyse PR campaign performance and prepare detailed reports.
- Handle crisis communication and provide timely responses to media enquiries.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging across all channels.

Profile

A successful Senior PR Executive should have:
- Strong experience in public relations or a related field.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proven ability to manage media relationships effectively.
- Skills in creating and implementing PR strategies.
- Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Familiarity with monitoring tools and analytics to measure campaign success.

Job Offer
- Permanent role with a hybrid working arrangement.
- Competitive salary ranging from £32,500 to £35,000, dependent on the level of experience.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Social Media & Content Creator
description:
Social Media & Content Creator

Manchester Hybrid - 2/3 days in the office

Our client is looking for an outgoing, creative and energetic Social Media & Content Creator to join their growing team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who lives and breathes social media, keeps up with the latest trends and news, and enjoys creating engaging content that gets people talking.

You'll be comfortable being the face of the brand, getting out and about to create content, interviewing people and finding creative ways to build an engaged online community.

The Role

You'll be responsible for creating and developing engaging social content across multiple platforms, helping grow the organisation's online presence and community.

This will include:
- Creating engaging video and social media content.
- Appearing on camera and being comfortable as a brand representative.
- Getting out and about to film vox pops, interviews and other content.
- Interviewing people for social media and turning conversations into engaging content.
- Keeping up to date with the latest social media trends, platforms, news and developments.
- Editing video and creating content suitable for different social channels.
- Developing creative ideas and campaigns that generate engagement.
- Helping build and grow an active online community.
- Monitoring what is happening in the news and identifying opportunities for relevant, topical content.
- Working with the wider marketing team to develop the organisation's social media presence and brand.

About You

We're looking for someone who is naturally outgoing, creative and energetic, with excellent people skills and a genuine passion for social media.

You'll ideally have:
- Experience creating social media content, particularly video.
- Strong video editing skills.
- Confidence appearing on camera.
- Experience interviewing people or creating vox-pop style content.
- A strong understanding of current social media trends and platforms.
- A genuine interest in current affairs and the latest news.
- Experience building or engaging online communities.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A creative approach and the confidence to try new ideas.
- The ability to work independently while collaborating with a wider team.
- A positive, energetic and engaging personality.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who understands what makes people stop scrolling and can turn ideas, conversations and current events into engaging social content.

Working Arrangements

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation that you'll be in the office around 2-3 days per week, as and when required.

If you're someone who enjoys being in front of the camera as much as behind it, loves social media, follows the news and wants to create content that genuinely connects with people, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now for more information.

Social Media & Content Creator

title: Ecommerce Executive
description:
Ecommerce Executive

Role Overview

The Ecommerce Executive supports the day-to-day running and optimisation of the ecommerce channel, ensuring a smooth customer journey and a high standard of accuracy and commercial focus.

You will be responsible for product catalogue uploads, managing product data and supporting onsite merchandising across launches, campaigns and BAU trading, including working with CSV files to maintain product information and content.

The role supports trading performance through analysis of customer behaviour, conversion and funnel performance, identifying opportunities to improve the onsite experience and overall performance.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help deliver a seamless onsite experience and contribute to ongoing site improvements, including trading reporting and highlighting key wins and opportunities across markets.

Responsibilities
- Support the day-to-day trading of the website, including product launches and seasonal campaigns, ensuring products, collections and content are correctly set up and optimised.
- Support product merchandising across collection and category pages, ensuring strong product visibility and clear navigation, working closely with merchandising and marketing teams to align launches and promotional activity.
- Take responsibility for product catalogue uploads via CSV, ensuring data accuracy and completeness, and coordinate pre- and post-launch checks to ensure all products and content are correctly set up and live.
- Manage and update product data on-site, including titles, descriptions, imagery and attributes.
- Conduct regular site checks to ensure accuracy across product data, pricing, imagery and content, including pre- and post-publish validation.
- Monitor website performance using Shopify Analytics and GA, tracking key KPIs such as conversion rate, revenue, AOV, CTR and engagement.
- Produce regular reports with clear insights, highlighting key wins, issues and opportunities to improve trading performance and conversion.
- Analyse customer behaviour using tools such as heatmaps, funnels and session recordings to identify friction points and opportunities for improvement.
- Support A/B testing and assist in implementing onsite improvements to enhance UX and conversion.
- Assist in managing and optimising ecommerce-related third-party apps and integrations.

Essential
- Above all else we are looking for a collaborative and positive team player who is kind and caring.
- 2+ years' experience in a similar ecommerce role.
- Hands-on experience managing product listings, uploads and merchandising on ecommerce platforms, preferably Shopify.
- Highly proficient in handling large data sets, including bulk product uploads and data management via CSV files, with strong Excel skills.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple launches and updates.

Desirable
- Experience with A/B testing and CRO.
- Experience working with AI-based tools or a curiosity to explore and apply AI within ecommerce.

Team Perks
- Private medical insurance
- Staff discount
- Flexible start and finish times
- Free on-site parking
- Company events
